notes: FB4's stored dace row, for reference (Parameters_official.csv, row 'Dace (adult & juvenile)', Phoxinus spp., source 'He 1986; Trudel and Boisclair 1994'): CEQ 2, CA 0.36, CB −0.31, CQ 2.3, CTO 26, CTM 29; REQ 2, RA 0.0148, RB −0.2, RQ 2.1, RTO 29, RTM 32, ACT 1; SDA 0.15; EGEQ 1, FA 0.4; EXEQ 1, UA 0.1; ED 5522 J/g. The fish behind it are northern redbelly and finescale dace (and their hybrid, in Trudel & Boisclair's Quebec lakes), not Rhinichthys or Semotilus. Trudel & Boisclair 1994 (CJFAS 51: 2558–2567) is the more likely home of the parameter values and of a field test of the dace model; it is also blocked (Trudel_Boisclair_1994.json).
